name: integrations
label: Integrations
description: Connectors to the services on your own network. Plex: libraries, recently added, on-deck and search. UniFi: health and the client list. Spotify: connect once, then read what is playing and control it. Read-only except Spotify playback, and the tokens live in Settings > Integrations (masked) - the page's cards write the same keys.

steps: On /integrations, Plex card: the server URL (this machine uses https://magic-nas-01:32400 - a Tailscale name, so the server's own certificate is accepted) and the token. Token: Plex Web, open any item, the ... menu, Get Info, View XML, then copy X-Plex-Token from the new tab's address; or F12 > Application > Local Storage > app.plex.tv > myPlexAccessToken. Save, then test both.

Console URL (https://192.168.123.1 here) and an API key, not a password: UniFi OS > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations > API keys. The site is the API name, almost always **default** - the console's display name ("Dream Machine") is not an API name and gets a 401; the connector falls back to default and says so. Save, then test both.

Make an app at developer.spotify.com and register exactly http://127.0.0.1:7795/api/modules/integrations/spotify/callback as its redirect URI. Paste the client id and secret on the Spotify card, save, then Connect Spotify and approve. Playback control needs Spotify **Premium** - a free account can authorise and search, but play/pause/next return 403. Playback also needs Spotify awake on a phone or the desktop app; the device field takes part of a player name.

The connectors are agent tools as well: plex_recent, plex_on_deck, plex_search, unifi_status, unifi_clients, spotify_status, spotify_now, spotify_play. Ask in a chat or from the WhatsApp admin chat. Spotify play/pause are ask tools, so an unattended run cannot start music on its own.

Secret fields are blank-means-keep: save the card with the secret blank to keep the stored one. Disconnect Spotify clears its refresh token. Disabling or deleting this app removes this page and these help entries with it.
fixes: Plex says it is not answering

The URL is the server itself, not app.plex.tv - for example https://magic-nas-01:32400. A Tailscale or LAN name with its own certificate is fine; the call skips certificate validation. A 401 means the token is wrong: copy it again from View XML. An empty 'recently added' list on a quiet library is not an error.
UniFi says it is not answering

It wants an API key, not the console password: Control Plane > Integrations > API keys. Use the console address, not the address of the network application. A 401 is usually the site field: the API name is default, not the console's display name like Dream Machine - the connector falls back to default and says so on the card. wlan warning and vpn unknown are normal.
Spotify says it is not connected

The Spotify app's redirect URI must be exactly http://127.0.0.1:7795/api/modules/integrations/spotify/callback. Save the client id and secret first, then Connect Spotify. Playback control requires Spotify **Premium**; a free account will 403 on play/pause but search and now-playing still work. If playback says there is no active device, start Spotify on a phone or the desktop app, or put part of the player name in the device field.
